counter.definition: To respond to an offer with a different figure, as in a negotiation.
counter.example: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.

dpn_walk_away_price.definition: The price above which the deal is worse than your best alternative.
dpn_walk_away_price.example: He set his walk-away price the week before, and he did not move it in the room.
